messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and timeouts observed for /v1/generate in prod (us-west-2). Error rate 5xx = 8% (baseline 0.5%), p95 latency up from 120ms -> 2.4s, p99 ~ 9.1s. Sampling shows gateway timeouts and internal 502s. Auto-page to on-call Alex.
Alex: saw the alert, pinging infra. Pulling Uptime/Grafana now.
Maria: I'm looking at the deployment timeline — we had a rollout 3m ago: commit 7f3c2a (kv-cache change + batching tweak).
Sam: adding traces from trace-collector. Spans show a bunch of long tail in model-proxy (~8-10s) right after the new binary.
Alex: can we confirm if autoscaler kicked? checking node metrics.
Jess: Observed request queues spiking on gpu-pool-3, inflight tokens per worker doubled.
Alex: Risk assessment: customer-facing API degraded. I'm going to escalate to Incident SEV and start mitigation playbook. Sam, Maria, can you reproduce on staging? If not, rollback seems fastest.
Sam: staging doesn't have the same traffic patterns, but I can replay a sampled load locally. Starting now.
Maria: I checked the commit diff — caching change altered prefix eviction ordering. Might be causing more cache misses -> higher load on model-backend.
EngLead: tagging this as P1. Notify Support and TOC. SupportBot, post status page draft and create incident ticket.
SupportBot: Draft status posted: "Investigating elevated errors for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Engineers are investigating." Ticket created: INC-2026-174612.
Alex: Decision: mitigate first (rollback to previous deploy) while we confirm root cause. Who can trigger rollback?
DeployBot: Deploy 7f3c2a -> started canary 00:02:00 ago. Current rollout at 60%. Rollback requires approval.
Jess: I'll hold traffic at the edge to existing stable variant for new requests if we can route. Can we shift traffic 100% to model-variant-v1 (previous) via feature-flag?
Maria: Feature-flag exists but not ideal for in-flight canary. Rollback is cleaner.
Alex: Jess, do the edge route if quick. Sam, run synthetic load against previous binary to validate latency. Maria, start rollback once DeployBot has approval.
Jess: Applying route now: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.local/route -d '{"service":"generate","target":"variant-v1","percent":100}'`
Jess: route change acknowledged, traffic shift in progress. Watching error-rate panels.
Sam: Synthetic run against v1 shows p95 ~140ms, p99 ~300ms under replay. Good.
DeployBot: Rollback triggered: undo rollout for deploy 7f3c2a -> rolling back to 7e9b11. Estimated completion 90s.
incident-bot: Rollback in progress. Notifying on-call and channels.
Alex: Monitoring logs and traces during rollback. Any 5xx deltas?
Jess: Error-rate trending down. 5xx is at 4% -> 1.2% -> now 0.6% and counting. p99 dropping back under 400ms.
Maria: Heap and connection metrics on model-backend returning to normal. Cache hit rate improving after traffic shifted.
Sam: Replay completed. No regression on v1.
EngLead: Good. Keep rollback until we understand root cause. Open postmortem and hold new rollout.
Alex: Assigning tasks: Maria to root-cause (PR diff + perf test), Sam to reproduce under load, Jess to verify routing controls and add an emergency rollback runbook tweak, EngLead to coordinate customer comms.
SupportBot: Notifying customers: status page updated with "Mitigated: rollback to previous version. Errors are decreasing; continuing monitoring."
DeployBot: Rollback complete, all services at 7e9b11. Canary canceled.
Alex: I'm going to hand off to Maria for night coverage in 30m — she'll be the incident owner for follow-ups. Sam, keep the replay logs pinned in the ticket.
Maria: Acknowledged, taking ownership. Will run deeper perf profiling and open a revert + fix PR if needed.
Jess: I'll add a temporary alert threshold lower to catch p95 jumps earlier and add a play to circuit-break new deploys if model-proxy latency > 2s for 1m.
EngLead: Postmortem timeline: create initial report with timeline, root cause hypothesis, impact (approx 12% of requests saw >2s latency, ~320 customer API calls failed), and mitigation steps.
SupportBot: Created follow-up incident summary in the ticket, added internal note to notify enterprise customers who reported errors.
Alex: Final checks — any lingering 5xx?
Jess: last check: 5xx at 0.12% (baseline). p95 130ms. p99 310ms. Good.
Maria: I'll schedule a canary dry-run with synthetic traffic and perf gates before reattempting rollout.
EngLead: Thanks team. We'll reconvene in the postmortem tomorrow. Closing this slack thread once the ticket is updated.
Sam: saved traces and flamegraphs to INC-2026-174612 artifacts.
Alex: Thanks all. Handing off to Maria.
Maria: acknowledged. Starting investigation notes now.
DeployBot: Incident channel note: rollback verified at 1746123578.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated at 1746123578. Continue monitoring for 1h.
